terms.gloss: a tray or small trough: the cat’s litter tray
terms.comment: Classically a small hollow vessel, “a tray, trough, basin” (Lewis & Short); its use for a cat’s litter tray is modern, and ours. Say alveolus fēlis where the context does not make it plain. No reference work we searched (Traupman, Morgan–Owens, Levi–Bini, Andresian) has a word for it. The litter is harēna (see “sand”); what the cat leaves, stercus (see “dung”).

phrases.latin: Alveolum fēlis pūrgā, et harēnam novam īnfunde.
phrases.english: Clean the litter tray, and put in fresh litter.
Scoop up the poo with the little shovel.

phrases.latin: pāstōrem eārum cum vatillō circumīre oportet ac stercus tollere ac cōnservāre
phrases.english: their keeper must go round with a little shovel, pick up the droppings, and keep them (of peacocks)

sources: Lewis & Short: alveolus · Lewis & Short: latrina · Lewis & Short: batillum
